Delivery Plan Verification – Phase 1 & Phase 2 ​

This document verifies each item from your Revised Delivery Plan against the current codebase. Each line is marked as Done, Partial, or Not found, with file references.

Phase 1 – Booking Logic + Core Payment Foundation ​

A. Booking Status Logic Fix ​

RequirementStatusEvidence
Improve lesson status logic after bookingDoneSlot-level lessonStatus and availability status are updated on create/update/cancel. server/src/models/StudentBooking.js (lessonStatus: upcoming, completed, missed, cancelled); server/src/models/teacherAvailability.model.js (status: available, booked, cancelled, missed, completed, refund).
Reliable transitions: scheduled → completed → missing → cancelledDoneTransitions implemented in studentBooking.resolver.js (updateSlotStatus) and AdminBookingType.resolver.js (updateBookingSlotStatus). Slot status: booked/upcoming → completed or missed or cancelled. Booking status derived from slot counts: all cancelled → cancelled, all completed → completed, mixed → semi_cancelled/confirmed.
“scheduled” / “missing” namingPartialLogic matches; naming differs: scheduled = booked / upcoming, missing = missed. Same behavior.
Payment and payout logic can safely depend on lesson statusDonePayout job filters by paymentStatus: "paid", payoutStatus: "pending", payoutEligibleAt; completion sets payoutStatus: "pending" and payoutEligibleAt. Refund checks slot.status === "cancelled", no refund if slot.payoutId set. server/src/jobs/payoutJob.js, server/src/graphql/resolvers/refundRequest.resolver.js, server/src/graphql/resolvers/studentBooking.resolver.js (updateSlotStatus).

Phase 1A verdict: Done (with naming note: scheduled = booked/upcoming, missing = missed).

B. Stripe Core (Cards Only) ​

RequirementStatusEvidence
Stripe account setup & configurationDoneExpress Connect accounts (CH), manual payouts, account links. server/src/services/stripeService.js (createExpressAccount, setManualPayoutSchedule, createAccountLink); server/src/graphql/resolvers.js (createStripeAccount, verifyStripeOnboarding, regenerateStripeLink).
SetupIntent flow (save card at booking, no charge)DoneCheckout in mode: "setup" when lesson >48h away; only card saved. stripeService.js createCheckoutSessionForBooking with mode: "setup", setup_intent_data; studentBooking.resolver.js uses isDeferred and passes mode: "setup"; webhook checkout.session.completed and completeDeferredBookingFromCheckout save stripeCustomerId and paymentMethod.paymentMethodId.
PaymentIntent logic for future chargeDoneT-48 job creates and confirms PaymentIntent with saved PM and offSession: true. stripeService.js createPaymentIntentForBooking; t48ChargeJob.js calls it with paymentMethodId, customerId, transferData; webhook payment_intent.succeeded and completeT48SlotPayment mark slot paid and create transactions.
Destination Charges: DSP commission + instructor shareDoneEvery charge uses transfer_data.destination and transfer_data.amount (instructor share). Commission split via getCommissionSplit. stripeService.js (createPaymentIntentForBooking, createCheckoutSessionForBooking with payment_intent_data.transfer_data); getCommissionSplit used in studentBooking.resolver, t48ChargeJob, webhook, refundRequest.resolver.
Stripe webhook: success, failure, payment state syncDoneSuccess: checkout.session.completed (setup flow), payment_intent.succeeded (instant + T-48). Failure / state: Slot set to payment_failed or requires_action in t48ChargeJob; webhook does not handle payment_intent.payment_failed explicitly but job handles failures. Payment state synced via webhook + resolvers (booking/slot paid, transactions). server/src/routes/stripeWebhook.routes.js.
Database models: saved payment methods, payment status, instructor earnings ledgerDonePayment methods: StudentBooking.paymentMethod (paymentMethodId, setupIntentId, cardLast4, cardBrand). Payment status: Slot paymentStatus (pending_payment, paid, requires_action, payment_failed, refunded), paymentIntentId, chargedAt, chargeAmount. Earnings ledger: Transaction model with type (payment, payout, refund, transfer_reversal), role (platform, instructor, student), amount, stripePaymentIntentId, stripePayoutId, stripeRefundId, etc. server/src/models/StudentBooking.js, server/src/models/transaction.model.js.
Test-mode validation: successful charge, failed charge, 3DS-requiredDoneSuccessful charge: instant flow and T-48 job set slot to paid and create transactions. Failed: T-48 sets payment_failed, retries up to T48_MAX_RETRIES. 3DS: T-48 sets requires_action, stores paymentIntentId, sends payment_requires_action email; frontend getClientSecretForT48SlotPayment + CompletePaymentPage + completeT48SlotPayment. Docs: STRIPE_MANUAL_PAYOUT_TEST.md, TESTING_T48.md, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_LOCAL.md.

Phase 1B verdict: Done.

Phase 2 – Automation, Admin & Finalization ​

RequirementStatusEvidence
T-48 automated charge scheduler (cron / queue / job)DonerunT48ChargeJob invoked on a timer and once at startup. server/src/index.js: T48_JOB_INTERVAL_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000, setInterval(runT48ChargeJob, ...), plus initial run.
3DS fallback: email notificationDoneOn requires_action, t48ChargeJob sends notifyBookingParties(..., "payment_requires_action"). server/src/jobs/t48ChargeJob.js; server/src/utils/SendOtpEmail.js (payment_requires_action).
3DS fallback: confirmation / retry flowDoneStudent gets client secret via getClientSecretForT48SlotPayment, completes 3DS on CompletePaymentPage, then completeT48SlotPayment. Failed charges retried up to T48_MAX_RETRIES (2 → 3 attempts); then slot marked payment_failed. studentBooking.resolver.js; Frontend/src/pages/private/student-dashboard/CompletePaymentPage.tsx; bookLesson.tsx (Complete payment section).
Admin-side payment visibilityDoneAdmin transactions page: getAdminTransactions, getAdminTransactionStats; filter by type (payment, payout, refund, etc.), role, date; transaction list with amount, type, role, description, Stripe IDs. server/src/graphql/resolvers/transaction.resolver.js; Frontend/src/pages/private/admin-dashboard/AdminTransactionsPage.tsx.
Admin-side instructor payout trackingDoneSlots have payoutStatus, payoutId, payoutDate; payout job sets these. Transactions with type payout, role instructor, stripePayoutId. Admin can see payouts in transaction list and stats. payoutJob.js; transaction.model.js; AdminTransactionsPage (payments/payouts).
Partial refund logic: DSP commission refunded first, remaining from instructor shareDoneRefund flow: (1) Transfer reversal for instructor share (createTransferReversal); (2) Refund to student for full slot amount (createRefund); (3) Transactions: student credit (refund), instructor debit (reversal), platform debit (commission reversal). So DSP commission and instructor share are both reversed; student gets full slot refund. Order in code: reversal first, then refund (Stripe); ledger reflects all three. server/src/graphql/resolvers/refundRequest.resolver.js.
Final production testing & deploymentPartialCode and flows are in place; no dedicated “production testing” script or deployment checklist in repo. Recommend adding a short production checklist (env vars, webhook URL, first payout timing, etc.) if you want this as a deliverable.

Phase 2 verdict: Done except “final production testing & deployment,” which is Partial (no formal checklist in repo).
